features.title: Lower, consistent floor carriers
features.description: The standard Caverns floors now meet at 8.4 mm, much closer to the shared 8 mm OpenLOCK floor datum. The concealed pit trap uses 8.6 mm to preserve printable mesh detail.

features.title: Original sockets preserved
features.description: Socket cuts were regenerated from the pinned sculpts using their original port layouts, including the long floor's six ports. The complete 0–8 mm connector zone is unchanged.

features.title: Print meshes updated together
features.description: The full-detail floor STLs and removable pit-trap insert use the same per-piece height adjustment as the editor meshes.
